_readme: NY_SCH - Tier 2 PRE - box-acc-jobs-agent. Copied into each run's acc-jobs-inputs.json (scripts/new_run.py --area acc-jobs); the agent asks every <ask>.
Run after box-fe-jobs-agent (target.fe_run: its acc-handoff.json and FE job names). Decisions and history: README.md beside this file.

reference._source: SLB (Tier 1) - registry row SLB; its ACC chain: docs/reference/job-chains/reference-slb-acc.md [Devin read-only audit, 2026-10-21]
reference._books_csv: J-R3b in Tier 1 (SLB's labels) - copy it from the FE run's 01-evidence/
reference.mbj_source_env: <ask - the environment R1 (J-R2 for SLB) was run in: its rows and Tier 1 PROD's conf files disagree for OTC / CAP / IRS>
reference._template_book: 15 for every instrument: new-named, ACC steps in shell.conf; CAP's only MBJ row is book 10's (its values are taken from it, warned) [2026-10-21]

_instrument_source: registry minus the skip ones (cds) - the same run as the FE jobs [operator, 2026-10-08]

initial_accounting._source: [BOX job expert via operator, 2026-10-08]; db.conf only in SLB [Devin, 2026-10-21]

target._branch_const: the core call's branch argument is PGT_NY.PKG_GMBATCHPROCESS.CST_PK_BRA_NYSCH (= 20007.4, J-T1), never the PK typed in [BOX team via operator, 2026-10-22]; the same as the FE run's
target.fe_run: <ask - REQUIRED: the fe-jobs run of tier2-pre you treat as OK (frozen or not - no sign-off needed, BOX expert 2026-10-26) that built depos irs ccs otc cap (scripts/new_run.py --list runs/NY_SCH/tier2-pre/fe-jobs) - e.g. all_20261021_1; not depos/, depos-v2/ or irs_20261013_1 (one instrument each)>

constants._comment: every CST_ instrument constant the reference's branch-level db.conf lines use -> its name in PGT_NY.PKG_GMBATCHPROCESS (J-E4), or SAME - as the FE run's

controlm._source: the target's ACC Control-M folder - asked, never copied from SLB's
controlm.folder_name: <ask - NY's BOX ACC Control-M folder (proposed JACD-T2USNYAC-BOXAC-100068125, to confirm)>
controlm._ControlmServer: the folder file carries the DEV server, as NY's FE folder file - the same server as the FE folders [BOX team, 2026-10-26]; PRE / PRO per environment (open item 4zg)
controlm.SiteStandard: <ask - NY's ACC site standard (SLB's ACC folder: SCIB-SSJAC_D_GR_ALMNXTGN_CIB-BOXACC)>
controlm.Host: <ask - NY's ACC DEV host (NY's FE folder: bvmnglapgbod101.nngg.corp)>
controlm.Application: <ask - NY's BOX ACC Application (SLB's ACC folder: G-GBMSA-D-100068125_Des)>
controlm.CreatedBy: <ask every run - the user ID of the person running the agent [BOX team, 2026-10-26]>

renames._comment: old-named reference jobs the chain needs -> new-convention name (the script suggests one)
renames.GMBOX0028D04: <ask - SLB's depos ruler update (2855.65); suggested GMBX1NY00D03, as IRS / CCS / OTC / CAP's 00D03>

external_events._comment: waits no ACC or FE job emits (GBO, other folders) -> target event, KEEP, DROP, DROP-REVIEW, <OPEN ...>; the script lists them

mic._comment: not asked [BOX expert, 2026-10-27 - ADR 0017]: D12 per book + 00D13 for every instrument, MIC_SENDER_TYPE lastly; eod_template = the reference instrument whose D12 / D13 an instrument without them copies (optional - default: the first found)

mbj._sequence: the table's own PK sequence [BOX dev, 2026-10-26]; name read in Tier 1 (J-E11), the same expected in Tier 2 - the precheck SQL confirms it. FK_CALENDAR: the SLB row's (1.21), not read by MBJ [BOX expert, 2026-10-26]
mbj.auth_code: <ask - Tier 2 PRE's auth code (Q-G3c; the FE configs run's 00-inputs.md TARGET_AUTH_CODE)>

group_map._comment: empty: NY runs the global event groups, no branch copy [BOX ACC expert, 2026-10-22, ADR 0014]

mbj._missing_rows: CCS D08 (no MBJ row in any SLB book) runs from db.conf per book as in SLB, group 3555.65 [BOX expert, 2026-10-26, open item 4zq closed]; this map only overrides that

readiness._source: BOX_ACC.PKG_BATCHPROCESS_MBJ absent in Tier 2 (R5, operator 2026-10-21); being deployed by the BOX team - not a blocker for NY [2026-10-26]
